new.title: It All Starts with a Template
new.body: Create, import, search and group templates, all in the Workbench; click "New Template" to design your first label.

nav.title: Come Back Anytime
nav.body: Use the left navigation to switch pages and see "Help" for more; replay this tour from the bottom status bar.

new.title: Shape Your Label Here
new.body: Drag text, barcode, QR code and rectangle onto the canvas; set W / H in the top toolbar and preview before printing.

select.title: Fill In, Print Out
select.body: Data & Print turns template fields into a form: pick one, fill in the data, print a test; if none, create one in the Workbench.

excel.title: One Sheet, Many Labels
excel.body: Click "Download Excel Template" to get a sheet from template fields, one row per label; confirm each column's field on import.
